description: Concept-to-path bridge for the normalized layer of the VRK election corpus. For each concept, the normalized dotted path per election id. An election missing from a concept's paths does not publish (or does not normalize) that concept — see docs/DATA_GUIDE.md. `derived` holds concepts that no single path resolves: a resolver function name, the paths it reads and the states it returns. Every path in this file is resolved against every record by `python scripts/field_coverage.py`, whose checked-in fill rates are docs/coverage-baseline.tsv: a mapped path that no record fills has to be classified there, and a rate that falls fails the run.
verified: 2026-08-19 against every record of the 20 elections then under data/; 2026-08-21 for the six 2015 elections added since, against their parsed records (complete fields for the three small ones, fixture sets for the three large ones). 2026-08-21 for the five 1996-1998 archive elections added since: the two municipal ones (1997-kovo-23-savivaldybiu-tarybu, 1997-birzelio-29-svenciniu-tarybos-pakartotiniai) against their parsed records for the ten concepts their anketa/kandidatavimas sections actually publish (kebab-case keys shared with the 2015 and 2016 eras, so no era-specific path shape); the three Seimas archive elections (1996-spalio-20-seimo and its two 1997 repeats) were then believed to publish none of the existing concepts, and appeared only in the elections list. That was wrong and was corrected 2026-08-26 (issue #69): their kandvl.htm card does carry a questionnaire, three of whose fields sit inside a malformed HTML comment invisible to a DOM parser. Ten concepts are now mapped for them, re-verified against all 906 re-parsed records — gimimo-vieta 861, tautybe 448, uzsienio-kalbos 732, seimine-padetis 772, vaiku-vardai-pavardes 690, sutuoktinio-vardas-pavarde 649, issilavinimas 357, visuomenine-veikla 113, kita-apie-save 38 (the 1996 general election only; neither 1997 repeat prints the label), pagrindine-darboviete 28 — plus the gimimo-data they already had. iskele stays unmapped: their candidacy is a list (single- and multi-mandate seats can both apply) rather than the single value every existing concept path assumes. Same pass added sutuoktinio-vardas-pavarde and vaiku-vardai-pavardes to the two municipal archive elections (4,151/4,268 and 83/85 records). 2026-08-21 for the four 2012-2014 elections (2012-seimo, 2013-kovo-3-seimo-birzai-zarasai-ukmerge, 2014-prezidento, 2014-ep): same era and key set as the 2015 elections, paths copied from 2015-kovo-1-seimo-zirmunai and validated against every parsed record; the presidential election maps no iskele (self-nominated) and no ar-buvote-pripazintas-kaltu (its form asks the eligibility set, not Q9.2), the EP election no kita-apie-save (no Q21), and neither 2014 election a declaration period (their note paragraph is empty). 2026-08-22 for 2009-prezidento: the 2014 presidential paths copied and validated against all seven parsed records (same concept set — no iskele, no ar-buvote-pripazintas-kaltu, no declaration period). Same day for 2009-ep: the 2014 EP paths (plus kita-apie-save, which its Q21 publishes) validated against the fifteen fixture records. Same day for 2008-seimo: the 2012 Seimo paths validated against the eight fixture records. Same day for the 2009 and 2011 Seimo by-elections: the 2013 paths validated against their complete fields (17 and 9 records). Same day for 2007-spalio-7-seimo-dzukija: the 2013 paths validated against its complete field (10 records); gimimo-data resolves through anketa because the era parser folds the card's date in. Same day for 2011-vasario-27-savivaldybiu: the 2015 municipal general's paths validated against the ten fixture records (same era, same municipal key set; the election adds no concept of its own). Same day for 2007-vasario-25-savivaldybiu: the 2011 municipal general's paths validated against the ten fixture records; savivaldybe resolves through kandidatavimas (the 2007 card names the electoral district, not the municipality), kita-apie-save is unmapped (not asked) and so is the declaration period (no note paragraph); the election's own keys — anketa.seimos-nariai and pareiskimai.ar-pasyvioji-rinkimu-teise-neapribota — map to no existing concept. 2026-08-23 for 2004-ep: the 2009 EP paths (the same question set, five years earlier) validated against its complete field (241 records); porinkiminis-numeris is unmapped as for the other pre-2016 results-joined elections — the 2004 rank lives in kandidatavimas.porinkiminisNumerisSarase, a results-tree join outside the normalized layer — and so is the declaration period (no note paragraph). Same day for 2004-seimo: the 2012 Seimo paths (the same Seimas question set, under the 2016 keys) validated against its complete field (1,251 records); the declaration concepts resolve on 1,250 — Žiobakienė has no declarations page — and the section is present on 1,249 asset extracts (Matkevičius's page prints the income extract only); porinkiminis-numeris is unmapped as for 2004-ep (kandidatavimas.porinkiminisNumerisSarase, a results-tree join), and so is the declaration period. Same day for 2005-lapkricio-20-seimo-kedainiai: the 2004 Seimas paths validated against its complete field (5 records). Same day for 2000-seimo: the 2004 Seimas paths for the fields the 2000 card asks, validated against the fifteen fixture records; tautybe, kita-apie-save and naryste-politinese-organizacijose are unmapped (not asked), porinkiminis-numeris as for the other results-joined elections (kandidatavimas.porinkiminisNumerisSarase), the declaration period likewise; the asset concepts are unmapped because the 1990s form sums turtas and piniginės lėšos (turto-ir-pajamu-deklaracijos.turtas-ir-pinigines-lesos-metu-pradzioje carries the combined figure), so only income, tax and currency resolve. Same day for 2000-kovo-19-savivaldybiu-tarybu: the 2000 Seimas paths for the fields the municipal card asks, validated against the ten fixture records; issilavinimas resolves through anketa.issilavinimas.aprasas (the form asks the level, as 1997), iskele through kandidatavimas.tarybosNarys.partyList (the card prints the list in the genitive) and savivaldybe through kandidatavimas.savivaldybe as for 2007; tautybe, sutuoktinio-vardas-pavarde, vaiku-vardai-pavardes, pomegiai, kita-apie-save and naryste-politinese-organizacijose are unmapped (not printed), porinkiminis-numeris as for the other results-joined elections, the asset concepts as for 2000-seimo. 2026-08-24 for 2004-prezidento: validated against its complete field (5 records) — the tree asks no questionnaire, so only the prose-recovered birth date (anketa.gimimo-data, from the .doc biography, all five resolving) and the declaration concepts (the 2004-ep page shape, all five) map; gimimo-vieta is unmapped (the five birthplace phrases are the prose helper's documented misses), iskele is unmapped (presidential candidates self-nominate and the card names no nominator), and the declaration period likewise (no note paragraph). Same day for 2002-prezidento: validated against its complete field (17 records) — the questionnaire and declarations exist only as scans (archived and linked, never OCR'd), so no declaration concept maps and only the prose-recovered birth facts do: gimimo-data (anketa.gimimo-data, 16 of 17; Bernatonis's biography gives a year alone) and gimimo-vieta (anketa.gimimo-vieta, 10 of 17); iskele is unmapped (self-nominated, no nominator on the card). 2026-08-26 for 1998-lapkricio-15-seimo-pakartotiniai (issue #23), the first election added to the Seimas archive family since its card questionnaire became readable: the same ten concepts as its siblings, validated against all 11 records — gimimo-data 6, gimimo-vieta 5, tautybe 10, issilavinimas 10, uzsienio-kalbos 10, seimine-padetis 7, sutuoktinio-vardas-pavarde 8, vaiku-vardai-pavardes 9, pagrindine-darboviete 10, visuomenine-veikla 4. kita-apie-save is not mapped: no card of this election prints the label. Same day for 1998-kovo-22-seimo-pakartotiniai (issue #21, one election over two constituencies): nine concepts, validated against all 11 records — gimimo-data 9, gimimo-vieta 9, tautybe 5, issilavinimas 8, uzsienio-kalbos 7, seimine-padetis 6, sutuoktinio-vardas-pavarde 6, vaiku-vardai-pavardes 5, pagrindine-darboviete 8. visuomenine-veikla and kita-apie-save are not mapped here, unlike the siblings: no card of this election prints either label (verified against the raw cards, 0 of 11). Same day for 1999-kovo-21-seimo-pakartotiniai (issue #24), the last election of the Seimas archive family and its only directory outside seim96/seimpk: ten concepts, validated against all 22 records — gimimo-data 15, gimimo-vieta 16, tautybe 20, issilavinimas 21, uzsienio-kalbos 21, seimine-padetis 12, sutuoktinio-vardas-pavarde 16, vaiku-vardai-pavardes 19, pagrindine-darboviete 20, visuomenine-veikla 16. kita-apie-save is not mapped: no card of this election prints the label (0 of 22). 2026-08-28 for teistumo-detales (issue #86): six elections added to its paths — 2016-seimo, 2017-balandzio-23-seimo-anyksciai-panevezys, 2018-rugsejo-16-seimo-zanavykai, 2019-ep, 2019-rugsejo-8-seimo and 2020-seimo, whose modules had mapped no conviction key at all — and the concept re-verified against every record of all 17 elections that now carry it (33,093 records, one shape, 943 non-empty). The derived teistumas concept was measured the same day over all 113,073 records: neklausta 7,470, ne 103,973, deklaruota-be-detaliu 352, deklaruota 1,278. The two 2017 mayoral elections and 2019-prezidento stay unmapped for the details — their pages publish no detail table. 2026-08-29 for the two elections that had reached the corpus without ever being mapped — issue #85, found by scripts/field_coverage.py, which could not see them at all. 2002-gruodzio-22-savivaldybiu-tarybu takes the 2000-kovo-19 municipal paths, validated against all 10,138 records: iskele, savivaldybe, ar-buvote-pripazintas-kaltu 10,138, gimimo-data 10,137, deklaraciju-valiuta 10,135, gautos-pajamos 10,119, sumoketas-pajamu-mokestis 10,060, pinigines-lesos 9,960, gautos-paskolos 9,433, suteiktos-paskolos 9,420, issilavinimas 9,302 (through anketa.issilavinimas.aprasas, the level, as in 2000), gimimo-vieta 9,295, tautybe 9,264, seimine-padetis 8,834, pagrindine-darboviete 8,800, uzsienio-kalbos 8,697, vaiku-vardai-pavardes 7,817, sutuoktinio-vardas-pavarde 7,286, visuomenine-veikla 3,297. privalomas-registruoti-turtas and vertybiniai-popieriai-meno-kuriniai-juvelyriniai-dirbiniai stay unmapped because this declaration prints them as one combined „bendra vertė“ row, as the 1990s form does; pomegiai because its question 18 is not asked (one stray record of 10,138); porinkiminis-numeris as for the other pre-2016 results-joined elections (kandidatavimas.porinkiminisNumerisSarase); kita-apie-save, naryste-politinese-organizacijose and the declaration period because the anketa does not print them. 2003-birzelio-15-seimo-nauji takes the 2004-seimo paths — the same static site a year earlier — validated against all 27 records: gimimo-data, gimimo-vieta, issilavinimas (irasai), uzsienio-kalbos, seimine-padetis, iskele, ar-buvote-pripazintas-kaltu and deklaraciju-valiuta 27, tautybe and naryste-politinese-organizacijose 26, pagrindine-darboviete, gautos-pajamos and sumoketas-pajamu-mokestis 25, pinigines-lesos 24, sutuoktinio-vardas-pavarde, vaiku-vardai-pavardes and pomegiai 23, visuomenine-veikla 15, kita-apie-save 5, suteiktos-paskolos 4, gautos-paskolos 0. That last one is mapped rather than dropped: the row is printed on every page and holds „-“ on all 27, so it is recorded as a zero in the coverage baseline. The two asset concepts stay unmapped for the same combined-row reason as 2002, and savivaldybe and porinkiminis-numeris do not apply to a Seimas by-election. 2026-08-30 for iskele (issue #82): the concept's paths became the per-election resolution order for scraper/shared/nominator.py -- ordered lists where one path does not cover an election -- and were extended to the six 1996-1999 Seimas archive elections (their candidacy list resolves via list fan-out), 2019-ep and 2024-ep (profilis.kita.sarasas), the split 2016/2020/2024 Seimas cards (sarasas fallback), the 2019/2023 municipal generals (tarybosNarys.partyList join) and the self-nomination label of the 2011/2015 municipal era. Verified against every record: all 51 mapped non-presidential elections plus 2024-prezidento resolve a nominator on 113,028 of 113,028 records.

gimimo-data.note: For the 1996-1998 Seimas archive elections the value is derived from the biography's opening sentence rather than a published field (those pages have none); each such record carries anketa.gimimo-data-saltinis = 'biografijos-tekstas'. Present on 692 of that family's 906 records; a further 157 have only anketa.gimimo-metai (year, never a date).

gimimo-vieta.note: For the 1996-1998 Seimas archive elections the value comes from the card's own "Gimimo vieta" field on 852 of 906 records; on 9 more it is derived from the biography's opening sentence and the record carries anketa.gimimo-vietos-saltinis = 'biografijos-tekstas'. The marker's absence means the field was published.

tautybe.note: Not published in the 2024 and 2025 elections.

issilavinimas.note: Both 1990s archive families write null at anketa.issilavinimas for a candidate who published no education level, where every era from 2007 on always writes the {aprasas, irasai} object (with an empty irasai when there is nothing). So their path stops at the object rather than at .irasai: appending it would fail to resolve on 1,192 of their 7,292 records. The value, when there is one, is the same object -- the card's single controlled level in the entry's own issilavinimas field. Inside irasai[], 2004-ep spells the institution key mokyklos-istaigos-pavadinimas (a slug of that page's own column heading, 360 of its 361 entries) where the other 53 elections write mokymo-istaigos-pavadinimas; read both, or resolve through scraper/shared/education.py :: issilavinimas(), which folds the alias. The level itself is not one path either: 2000-kovo-19 and 2002-gruodzio-22 answer it in issilavinimas.aprasas with empty irasai, and 2000-seimo, 2002-prezidento and 2004-prezidento publish no level at all -- the derived issilavinimo-lygis concept resolves all of it.

darbo-patirtis.note: The 2020-era biography's work-history table: irasai of {darbo-pradzia, darbo-pabaiga, darboviete, pareigos}. 17,666 records across this era's 11 elections publish at least one entry; mapped for issue #87, which found it displayed nowhere.

visuomenine-veikla.note: 2020-seimo's question wording is wider (scientific + pedagogical activity); the key is shared.

naryste-politinese-organizacijose.note: Three value shapes: plain string (2016 era), free text under .tekstas (2020–2023), record list under .irasai with politine-organizacija/nuo/iki items (2024 on).

iskele.note: The resolution order for scraper/shared/nominator.py: where the value is a list, the paths are tried in order and the first non-empty string wins (issue #82). The 2016/2020/2024 Seimas cards print 'Iškėlė' only for constituency candidacies and the list under 'Sąrašas'; the 2019/2023 municipal cards print it only for mayoral candidacies, and a council candidate's list is the results join kandidatavimas.tarybosNarys.partyList (a dict there, a bare string in 2000/2002); the 2011/2015-era municipal pages mark a self-nominated candidate with a bare label, so profilis.kita.issikeles-kandidatas.pavadinimas -- the label itself, 'Išsikėlęs kandidatas' -- is the value, and the party registry maps it to the self-nomination entry. The 1996-1999 Seimas archive family's candidacy is a list under normalized.kandidatavimas (a candidate could stand in a constituency and on a party list at once), which path resolution fans out over in order. 2019-prezidento, 2002/2004/2009/2014-prezidento stay unmapped: their candidates self-nominate by law and their pages name no nominator; 2024-prezidento does name one. Resolved non-null on all 113,028 records of every mapped election on 2026-08-30.

porinkiminis-numeris.note: Absent from the presidential elections, which have no lists.

ar-buvote-pripazintas-kaltu.label-lt: Ar buvote pripažintas kaltu dėl nusikalstamos veikos
ar-buvote-pripazintas-kaltu.note: 19 of 20 elections; the 2019 presidential questionnaire asks constitutional eligibility questions instead and has no conviction declaration.

teistumo-detales.note: One shape everywhere since issue #86 (2026-08-28): {"irasai": [...]}, one entry per conviction, empty when none was declared, present on every record of the 17 elections whose pages publish the block (33,093 records). Entries carry nuosprendzio-data/-valstybe/-institucija in every era; the 2016-2021 entries add the free-text nusikalstama-veika (the offence), the Rinkimu kodekso era (2023 on) a nusikalstamos-veikos list of structured offence records whose kesinimosi-objektas-... field holds the same thing. Before that fix six of these elections mapped no conviction key at all and 2023-2025 records still carried the retired null-field skeleton; use the derived teistumas concept to avoid caring.

vertybiniai-popieriai-meno-kuriniai-juve.label-lt: Vertybiniai popieriai, meno kūriniai, juvelyriniai dirbiniai

turtas-ir-pinigines-lesos.note: The 1996-2000 form's single combined wealth row -- property and cash in one figure, litas. That era leaves the modern split keys (privalomas-registruoti-turtas, vertybiniai-popieriai-..., pinigines-lesos beyond its own row) as null placeholders, so a consumer summing the documented seven keys reads 0 for 17,654 declarations that do state their wealth here (issue #97). Resolve totals through the deklaruotas-turtas derived concept, which names the measure.

turtas-ir-pinigines-lesos-metu-pradzioje.note: The 1996-2000 archive form's start-of-year twin of turtas-ir-pinigines-lesos.

turtas-ir-vertybiniai-popieriai.note: The 2002 municipal form's combined property-and-securities row -- a third wealth shape, distinct from both the 1990s combined row (which folds cash in) and the 2004-on split rows. Its cash lives in the separate pinigines-lesos row, so the era's total is this row plus that one; the deklaruotas-turtas derived concept does the sum and names the measure.

gautos-pajamos-darbo-santykiu.note: Row 1 of the 1996-2000 archive form's income section - employment income alone. The deklaruotos-pajamos derived concept substitutes it where the form's own total (row 20) is refused; mapped in its own right so the split stays visible.

deklaraciju-valiuta.note: Mapped for every election that publishes a declaration block before 2016: the key is "Lt" on all of them (79,071 records) and absent from 2016 on, where the figures are euro -- no record anywhere says "EUR", so the euro era is marked by the key's absence. scraper/shared/deklaracijos.py :: deklaracijos_valiuta() turns that absence into an explicit "EUR" for consumers (issue #97).

states.neklausta: The questionnaire has no conviction question, or left it unanswered - the 2019 presidential form, the 1990s archive cards, the elections with no anketa at all. Not a denial.
states.ne: Asked and denied. The answer is 'Ne' on the Seimas and municipal forms, 'Nera' on the 2000 and 2004 static-site ones.
states.deklaruota-be-detaliu: Declared, and the page publishes no detail: one yes/no question and nothing else. Upstream, not a parse loss - checked against the retained HTML.
states.deklaruota: Declared, with detail: a structured conviction table, a free-text explanation, or both.

teistumas.note: Measured over all 113,073 records on 2026-08-28. The affirmative of each question follows its wording: Taip/Ne on the Seimas and municipal forms, Yra/Nera on the 2000 and 2004 static-site ones (which ask whether there is anything to declare), Buvo/Nebuvo on that era's grave-crime question, Turiu/Neturiu on the unserved-sentence one. The main question itself only ever takes Taip (1,614), Yra (16), Ne and Nera, so a consumer filtering on 'Taip' misses sixteen of its 1,630 declarers. The four neighbouring conviction declarations are different questions and do not move busena, but they are returned under kiti-pareiskimai: 53 records answer one affirmatively and 20 of those deny the main question, so 1,650 records declare a conviction somewhere. The resolver flattens both entry shapes to one: data / valstybe / institucija / veikos (a list of offence names), with the stored entry kept under saltinis.

states.deklaruota-suma: The declared total, which is what every era from 2004 on publishes and what gautos-pajamos holds.
states.darbo-santykiu: Row 1 of the 1996-2000 form, employment income alone. That form prints rows 1 and 20 of its income section and row 20 fails by rendering 0 against a non-zero row 1, so the parser refuses it and gautos-pajamos is null; row 1 is nonetheless printed and is the only income figure those records have. A floor on what was declared, not the total.

deklaruotos-pajamos.note: Measured over all 113,073 records on 2026-08-29. The 4,628 that resolve to the employment row are 4,463 of 1997-kovo-23-savivaldybiu-tarybu's 6,276, 147 of 2000-kovo-19-savivaldybiu-tarybu, 9 of 1996-spalio-20-seimo, 8 of 2000-seimo and 1 of 1997-birzelio-29-svenciniu-tarybos-pakartotiniai — every one of them a page whose row 20 total the parser refused because the page's own row 1 contradicts it (scraper/shared/deklaracija_archive_1990s.py). The 969 with neither figure are the records with no declaration at all (2002-prezidento publishes only scans) plus the archive pages VRK froze an Oracle error into. A consumer reading gautos-pajamos alone reports the 4,628 as having declared nothing, which is not what their page says (issue #98).

inputs: the iskele concept's ordered path lists (scraper/shared/nominator.py)

states.partija: The nominator is a registered party's registry entry.
states.koalicija: A coalition entry, or a joint nomination naming more than one organisation; its member party ids are under `nariai` where the name states them.
states.issikelimas: Self-nominated: the pure 'Iškėlė pats' forms and the 2011/2015-era bare label. A line naming a party plus 'išsikėlė pats' counts as the party, because the line names it.
states.neiskelta: No nominator resolves: the five presidential elections whose candidates self-nominate by law and whose pages name none. Not a parse loss.
states.nezinoma: A nominator resolved and no registry entry claims it. Zero today; a new surface form upstream lands here, in the registry's `unmatched` block, and in a red tests/test_party_registry.py until classified.

partija.note: Measured over all 113,073 records on 2026-08-30 (issue #82). Returns partija-id (the scraper/parties.json entry), partija-vardas-raw (the string the record carries, kept verbatim) and tipas (the states above). The corpus has no cross-election party identifier of its own -- the ids VRK publishes are per-municipality list ids or per-election rorg ids, none shared between two elections -- so identity is created by the registry: 427 measured surface forms, each an exact alias of exactly one of its 340 entries. Matching is exact alias, then a punctuation/case fold (dashes, quote glyphs, whitespace, case -- never grammatical de-inflection: the genitive forms the 2000/2002 sarasas prints are explicit aliases, proven by pairing them with the nominative partyList on the same records), then unmatched. Renames stay one entry with the old name as an alias (LVŽS spans 2001-2025); mergers get a new entry with `predecessors` (TS-LKD points at Tėvynės sąjunga and LKD, so the pre-2008 forms group under the predecessor, not anachronistically under TS-LKD). scripts/nominator_report.py re-measures this and docs/nominator-forms.tsv carries the measured forms.

states.nurodyta: A level was published and maps onto the 13-tier ordinal (education.py::LEVELS). lygis is the highest tier any of the record's level values states; nebaigtas flags an explicitly unfinished one.
states.nenurode: The page itself prints the decline (Issilavinimas: Nenurode), retained in rawData.anketa/biografija rows -- the 2016 and 2020 page eras only. A decline is an answer, not a gap.
states.neskelbta: The election publishes no level for anyone: 2000-seimo (institution/specialty/year but zero levels -- its true higher-education share is ~77%, and reading the null as 0% is an artefact), 2002-prezidento and 2004-prezidento (no questionnaire).
states.neatsakyta: The form asks the question and this page shows no answer -- the pre-2016 pages print no education row at all for a blank (verified against retained HTML).

issilavinimo-lygis.note: The bare 'Aukstasis' (39% of all level tokens) is a property of the form, not the candidate -- every election up to 2007-vasario offers it as the only higher-education option -- so it is its own tier (aukstasis-nedetalizuotas) and never collapsed into universitetinis/neuniversitetinis. Era-comparable questions use the coarse aukstasis boolean (rank >= aukstasis-nedetalizuotas). laipsnis reads the degree fields independently, including the eight elections whose page fused the degree and title questions into one row. Measured over all 113,073 records on 2026-08-30.

states.skaidytas: Property + securities + cash summed from the split rows every sectioned form (2004 on) publishes.
states.turtas-plius-lesos: The 1996-2000 form's single combined row, cash already included.
states.turtas-plius-vp: The 2002 form's property-and-securities row plus its separate cash row.

deklaruotas-turtas.note: The measure is decided by which era-marker key the block carries (the archive eras keep the modern keys as null placeholders, so presence of the era's own row decides, never value). Loans given/received are in none of the three sums. The figure is in the block's published currency; deklaracijos_valiuta() names it. Measured over all 113,073 records on 2026-08-30; 1,086 declarations state no wealth figure.

states.neto-archyvas: 1996-2002: 'Gauta pajamu (be mokesciu) suma' -- income net of tax (2002 family-scoped as well). Provable from the numbers: the modal tax/income ratio there is 0.40-0.52, above the era's 33% statutory rate, which a gross base cannot produce. Gross equivalent = gautos-pajamos + sumoketas-pajamu-mokestis (deklaruotos_pajamos_bruto).
states.deklaruota-apmokestinamos: 2018 on: 'Deklaruota apmokestinamuju ir neapmokestinamuju pajamu suma'; gross.

pajamu-matas.note: All four normalize to the same gautos-pajamos key with nothing marking the difference (issue #97) -- 23,141 populated records are on the net side. mokescio_matas() answers the same question for the tax row, whose meaning flips from tax paid ('Isskaiciuota (sumoketa) ...', sumoketas) to tax payable ('Deklaruota moketina ...', moketinas) with the 2018 rewording. Measured over all 113,073 records on 2026-08-30 (mokescio-matas: sumoketas 80,543, moketinas 31,674).

inputs: kandidatavimas (record root, camelCase: 2000-2015 and the municipal generals)
normalized.kandidatavimas (dict: 1997 municipal pair; list: 1996-1999 Seimas archive)
